SSCCS is a computational foundation that is structural, not alphabetical. Tables to space, hashing to coordinates, division to relation. We are redesigning computing from a stage prior to human language, where structure is universal and not a historical artifact of the Roman-script worldview.

Our project governs a holistic stack where the boundary between software and hardware is meaningless—a philosophical system that emerges through the interactions of its horizontal subprojects.

We oppose the erosion of the digital commons by concentrated power, and we reject the use of our craft for ends that diminish human dignity. But, at the same time, our foundation is neither a resistance movement nor a reactionary stance, nor an extension of Enlightenment idealism.

We replace the historical accident of the alphabet with principles that precede all human language: structure, coordinates, relation. These are not our inventions. They have always been there, waiting to be seen.

Their inherent power is the only protection humanity needs—not because they are moral, but because they are true. Our role is simply to reveal them, and to act as a fellow member of a software ecosystem that leads the wa by clarity.

## Core Concept

The formal definition of the model: what SSCCS is, the four primitives, and its relationship with conventional computing. See [SSCCS](ssccs.html).

## Manifesto

The ontological declaration: computation as collapse, time as coordinate, and the end of instruction. See [Manifesto](manifesto.html).

## Ecosystem

The horizontal subprojects that emerge from the shared substrate: each applies the four primitives to its own domain and strengthens the whole. See [Projects](../projects/).
